dialog.title: Credentials
dialog.intro: These are the logins we work with for you. When a password changes, enter it here – we’ll work with the new one right away.
dialog.trust: We store passwords and notes encrypted. Every time one is opened, it is logged.
dialog.loadError: The credentials could not be loaded.

secretField.clipboardFailed: Copying is not possible. Allow the browser to access the clipboard.

empty.title: No credentials yet
empty.description: To work for you we usually need three logins: your domain registrar, your hosting and your email account. Add them here instead of sending them by email – we store password and note encrypted.
empty.readOnlyDescription: As soon as we release a credential for you or someone on your team adds one, it appears here.

notConfigured.title: Credentials cannot be opened right now
notConfigured.description: A technical setting is missing on our side at the moment. Your credentials are stored safely. Showing, adding and changing work again as soon as we have fixed it – feel free to let us know in the chat.

owner.hint: In the portal view you can neither reveal nor change credentials.

form.notice: We store password and note encrypted. Only we and people in your company who are authorised can read them.

placeholders.title: e.g. Domain at IONOS
placeholders.note: e.g. customer number or sign-in hints

hints.secretKeep: Leave empty if the password has not changed.

note.exists: There is a note. It stays unchanged.
note.removed: The note will be removed when you save.

form.conflict: This credential was changed in the meantime. Your input is still here – check it and save again.

validation.secretRequired: Enter the password or API key.

errors.not_found: This credential no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.validation: That did not fit. Check your input – or a great many credentials are stored already.
errors.not_configured: Credentials cannot be saved or opened right now. Nothing was changed. Feel free to let us know.
errors.rate_limited: That was a lot of requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: That did not work. Please try again.
